summary: Frontend-only validation of the reworked 'Mappe & Percorsi' dialog on /eventi. All requested UX behaviors verified end-to-end against the preview backend: list rendering with distance + GPX status badges, create/edit/delete/view actions, mode-switching primary button ('Aggiungi percorso' <-> 'Salva modifiche'), '+ Nuovo percorso' reset, no-duplicate-on-edit (editingId set after initial create), dedicated GPX upload with parsing + distance auto-fill + Associato badge + Leaflet preview container (data-testid=gpx-map) + Scarica/Elimina GPX controls, GPX persistence and GPX removal round-trip, and delete via AlertDialog. Regression fields (Immagine/PDF/File/GoogleMaps/URL) render and save without errors. Mobile 390x844 shows the dialog usable (scrollable, primary button reachable).

issues: Auto-fill of Distanza from GPX only occurs when the field is empty (by design in code, but not documented in the UI — consider showing a hint like 'Distanza aggiornata automaticamente se vuota').
OSM tile layer does not load in the sandbox network (expected); polyline + start/end markers still render inside the gpx-map container.

critical_code_review_comments: Events.jsx is ~294 lines and mixes GPX parsing/haversine, Leaflet map component, and MapsDialog in the same file — consider extracting parseGpx/haversine and GpxMap into /components (reuse & testability).

Both eye (view) and pencil (edit) actions call the same loadForEdit — a true read-only 'view' mode is not implemented (form is editable regardless). If PM intended view-only, add a readOnly prop; otherwise consider dropping the eye button to avoid user confusion.
onGpxFile auto-fills distanza only when previous value is empty; if a user replaces the GPX file expecting the distance to update, it silently won't. Consider always updating or asking to confirm.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary percorso 'TESTP-<ts>' under the first event, verified edit-no-duplicate, GPX upload/persist/remove, then deleted it. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The AlertDialog (Elimina) inside the Dialog stacks a second Radix overlay; Playwright's force=True click on [data-testid=confirm-del-map-<id>] can still be marked as 'overlay intercepts pointer events'. Real users can delete without issue (verified via programmatic el.click() -> toast 'Percorso eliminato'). For future tests, use page.evaluate(el.click()) OR press Enter on the focused AlertDialogAction.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional bug found. Playwright false-positive on delete confirm click is due to two stacked Radix overlays (Dialog + AlertDialog) — bypass via native .click() in evaluate() or keyboard Enter.
